pb-books-settlement.heading: Record received settlements
pb-books-settlement.boundary: Record money already received in the client books. This makes no charge or bank transfer.
pb-books-settlement.tally: Tally settlement writes are planned until this installation is qualified. The bookkeeper can enter the reviewed payments manually.
pb-books-settlement.mapping: Use the connected client account and its mapped customer. Every payment must match an issued invoice and a verified cash or bank account.
pb-books-settlement.differences: Only the paid amount is recorded. Fees, unpaid balances and tax credits stay open for separate bookkeeper review.
pb-books-settlement.demo: Demo only: provider records are unavailable. No successful accounting write is invented.
pb-books-settlement.sourceHelp: Use the actual payout identity, paid date, time zone, payment method and provider account ID. Match every order in this month once.
pb-books-settlement.unknown: A payment may already exist. Check the client books manually. This work cannot be retried.
pb-books-settlement.stopped: Recording stopped. Check each recorded outcome before preparing new work.
pb-books-settlement.error.REQUEST_FAILED: Could not complete this check. Refresh and inspect the current work.
pb-books-settlement.error.BOOKS_READ_FAI: The existing books could not be read completely. Nothing new was sent.
pb-books-settlement.error.BOOKS_CONNECTI: Connect this client account for the current session.
pb-books-settlement.error.BOOKS_MAPPING_: Map this client customer in the accounting connection first.
pb-books-settlement.error.BOOKS_SOURCE_C: The source changed. Prepare the monthly reconciliation again.
pb-books-settlement.error.BOOKS_SETTLEME: Match each payout and resolve held or unexplained amounts before recording payments.
pb-books-settlement.error.BOOKS_MAPPING_: The invoice or account needs manual bookkeeper review.
pb-books-settlement.error.BOOKS_CONSENT_: This order needs current client consent.
pb-books-settlement.error.BOOKS_ALREADY_: This payout already exists or needs an outcome check. Do not repeat it.
pb-books-settlement.error.APPROVAL_STALE: The reviewed work changed. Refresh before deciding again.
